diagnosis.observation: The v3 edits landed: recall recovered 0.708 -> 0.917 and the round-2 classes (producing-step anchoring, quote sizing, unsimplification) produced no recurrences at error level — the remaining misses are different failures.

Precision is now the binding constraint (0.8125). The 5 false positives: ep00 x2 containment-floor detections of real errors against micro ground-truth spans; ep01 '8-4m' — a fragment stopping short of the false equality's computed value (V5 violation); ep05 '(f(f(f(f(1)))))' — a quote that does not appear in the solution at all, a hallucinated anchor (new failure mode); ep06 '$f(2)=2\times 2=4$' — anchored at the consequence, not the producing prose transition (V4 violation).

ep07 err_001: the perturber swapped a variable name in words ('substitute this value for $b$' -> 'for $a$'), and no claim came near it — a prose-level reasoning miss the symbol-level sweep does not cover.
ep06 err_003: the error is a prose transition ('Thus' -> 'Also, since the input is now 2, $f(2)=2\times$...'); the claim quoted the arithmetic consequence and could not align with the prose span.

ep00 err_001/err_002 and ep03 err_002 are structural: two spans failed the presence check (k_effective 1/3) and one sat inside a unit matched through a sibling. No verifier fix applies to any of the three.

policy_edits.change: Extended the sweep to the prose layer: changed logical connectors (Thus/Also/since), variable names swapped in words rather than symbols, restated conditions or ranges.

Added a verbatim pre-answer check: every quoted_text must appear verbatim in the solution under review (a quote not in the text is a hallucination and a guaranteed miss), and a quote must reach the false statement's computed value.

scorer_issues.pattern: Containment floor, third round running: both claims quote the complete equalities that contain the declared spans verbatim ('\sqrt{75x}=\sqrt{3\cdot 5\cdot x}', '\sqrt{2x}=\sqrt{2\cdot 2\cdot 2\cdot x}') and both fail the 40% floor against 6-10 char truth spans. Two of the five round-3 FPs are correct detections the matcher cannot credit. Same root as rounds 1-2: the floor penalises length-asymmetric true detections.
Unit-credit inflation, second occurrence: err_002 was never claimed yet its unit matched via a sibling, so the verifier received unit recall credit for an error it did not find.

convergence_reason: f1 moved +0.128 with precision the new binding constraint; a new miss class (prose-layer reasoning) and a new FP mode (hallucinated quotes) each have admissible edits. Not flattened.
